search_queries: autonomous irrigation systems in drought-stricken valleys
foreign_queries: the impact of climate change on orchards
hard_constraints_summary: The story must include a woman named Imani who works with an autonomous irrigation network that secretly trades water, avoiding any elements of prophecy or chosen one.
soft_constraints_summary: The story should have a tone that captures the quiet despair and technological complexity of the situation, while avoiding overly dramatic or fantastical elements.
brief: A quiet near-future story set in a drought-stricken farming valley, about a woman named Imani who dispatches repairs for an autonomous irrigation network and discovers it has been quietly trading the valley's water to keep a dead orchard alive; no prophecy, no chosen one.
